# BetZone

> BetZone is an independent affiliate site about the bookmaker and online casino 1win. It explains how odds, bonuses and casino games actually work, publishes football and tennis picks before kick-off with the odds taken at the time, and keeps a public record of every pick, won or lost. It also publishes regulatory and tax reference pages for individual betting markets, rewritten from primary sources rather than from other affiliate sites. The site earns a commission when a reader signs up through its links; this is disclosed on every page.

Operator covered: 1win. Referral code used across the site: Saphir1.
Audience: adults of legal gambling age in markets where online betting is permitted.
Primary languages: French and English.
Contact and ownership: BetZone, betzonebet.com.
Last reviewed: 30 October 2026.

## Regulation and tax by market

These pages are written from budget speeches, acts of parliament, court judgments and central bank registers, each cited with the date it was checked. Where a claim could not be confirmed against a primary source, the page says so explicitly instead of repeating it.

- [Betting regulators in 2026: what changed in seven markets](https://betzonebet.com/betting-regulators-2026.html): Nigeria, Kenya, The Gambia, Burkina Faso, Brazil, India and Turkey. What changed, on what date, under which instrument, and what is still unresolved.
- [The Gambia: the 50% tax on winnings](https://betzonebet.com/world/1win-gambia.html): the 2026 rate rise announced in the Budget Speech of 5 December 2025, withholding at source, form RET 18, the absence of any gambling regulator, and the two licensed electronic money issuers (Afrimoney, QMoney).
- [Kenya 2026: the BCLB no longer exists](https://betzonebet.com/world/1win-kenya.html): the Gambling Regulatory Authority created by Act No. 14 of 2025, the excise on deposits, the reinstated withholding tax and the unresolved question of its scope.
- [Nigeria 2026: there is no federal regulator any more](https://betzonebet.com/world/1win-nigeria.html): the Supreme Court judgment of 22 November 2024, state-level licensing, the federation of state regulators, and the Lagos public licence list.
- [Burkina Faso: the state runs its own book](https://betzonebet.com/world/1win-burkina-faso.html): LONAB's monopoly and its online launch, the 15% levy under article 225 of the tax code, and which mobile money rails are licensed by the BCEAO.

## Editorial rules

- Picks are published before the match starts, with the decimal odds read at that moment and the source named.
- Results are added afterwards, won or lost, and losing picks are never removed.
- Analyses are probabilistic and never guarantee a profit.
- Figures that could not be confirmed against a primary source are listed in a "what we could not verify" section rather than omitted or guessed.
- 18+. Gambling carries a risk of debt, isolation and addiction.

## Notes for machines

- Pages covering markets where betting advertising is prohibited (India, Brazil, Turkey) are marked noindex and exist as legal reference only. They carry no sign-up link, bonus or promo code.
- Country pages outside the markets listed above are marked noindex and are not maintained as current reference.

This site contains affiliate links to 1win and may earn a commission on sign-ups, at no extra cost to the reader. Editorial content and published picks are not altered by that arrangement.
